# AUTOGENERATED FROM 'app/queries/region_totals.edgeql' WITH:
#     $ gel-py


from __future__ import annotations
import dataclasses
import gel
import uuid


class NoPydanticValidation:
    @classmethod
    def __get_pydantic_core_schema__(cls, _source_type, _handler):
        # Pydantic 2.x
        from pydantic_core.core_schema import any_schema
        return any_schema()

    @classmethod
    def __get_validators__(cls):
        # Pydantic 1.x
        from pydantic.dataclasses import dataclass as pydantic_dataclass
        _ = pydantic_dataclass(cls)
        cls.__pydantic_model__.__get_validators__ = lambda: []
        return []


@dataclasses.dataclass
class RegionTotalsResult(NoPydanticValidation):
    id: uuid.UUID
    code: str
    name: str
    grower_count: int
    batch_count: int
    total_kilograms: float


async def region_totals(
    executor: gel.AsyncIOExecutor,
    *,
    region_codes: list[str],
) -> list[RegionTotalsResult]:
    return await executor.query(
        """\
        select Region {
          code,
          name,
          grower_count := count(.<region[is Grower]),
          batch_count := count(.<region[is Grower].<grower[is Batch]),
          total_kilograms := sum(.<region[is Grower].<grower[is Batch].kilograms)
        }
        filter (
          (not exists array_unpack(<array<str>>$region_codes)) or
          (.code in array_unpack(<array<str>>$region_codes))
        )
        order by .code asc;\
        """,
        region_codes=region_codes,
    )

import requests
import json

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8099"

def test_healthz():
    print("Testing GET /healthz...")
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/healthz")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {r.status_code}"
    assert r.json() == {"status": "ok"}, f"Expected status ok, got {r.json()}"
    assert r.headers["Content-Type"] == "application/json"
    print("GET /healthz passed.")

def test_growers_search_success():
    print("Testing POST /growers/search success...")
    payload = {
        "region_code": "NOR",
        "min_kilograms": 300,
        "certifications": ["organic"]
    }
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/growers/search", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {r.status_code}"
    data = r.json()
    assert data["region_code"] == "NOR"
    assert isinstance(data["growers"], list)
    # Check key order of growers and nested items
    assert list(data.keys()) == ["region_code", "growers"]
    if len(data["growers"]) > 0:
        grower = data["growers"][0]
        assert list(grower.keys()) == ["slug", "name", "region", "batches", "matched_batches", "matched_kilograms"]
        assert list(grower["region"].keys()) == ["code", "name"]
        if len(grower["batches"]) > 0:
            batch = grower["batches"][0]
            assert list(batch.keys()) == ["code", "kilograms", "harvested_on", "certifications"]
    print("POST /growers/search success passed.")

def test_growers_search_invalid():
    print("Testing POST /growers/search invalid...")
    # Missing required region_code
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/growers/search", json={})
    assert r.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {r.status_code}"
    assert r.json() == {"error": "invalid_request"}

    # Invalid region_code type
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/growers/search", json={"region_code": 123})
    assert r.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {r.status_code}"

    # Empty region_code
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/growers/search", json={"region_code": ""})
    assert r.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {r.status_code}"

    # Invalid min_kilograms type
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/growers/search", json={"region_code": "NOR", "min_kilograms": "abc"})
    assert r.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {r.status_code}"

    # Too many certifications
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/growers/search", json={"region_code": "NOR", "certifications": ["a"] * 9})
    assert r.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {r.status_code}"

    # Empty certification string
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/growers/search", json={"region_code": "NOR", "certifications": [""]})
    assert r.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {r.status_code}"
    print("POST /growers/search invalid passed.")

def test_get_batch_success():
    print("Testing GET /batches/<code> success...")
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/batches/BLK-101")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {r.status_code}"
    data = r.json()
    assert list(data.keys()) == ["code", "kilograms", "harvested_on", "certifications", "grower", "inspection_count"]
    assert list(data["grower"].keys()) == ["slug", "name", "region"]
    assert list(data["grower"]["region"].keys()) == ["code", "name"]
    print("GET /batches/<code> success passed.")

def test_get_batch_not_found():
    print("Testing GET /batches/<code> not found...")
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/batches/UNKNOWN")
    assert r.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {r.status_code}"
    assert r.json() == {"error": "not_found"}
    print("GET /batches/<code> not found passed.")

def test_create_inspection_success():
    print("Testing POST /inspections success...")
    payload = {
        "batch_code": "BLK-101",
        "inspector": "Jane Doe",
        "passed": True,
        "defect_codes": ["DF-01", "DF-01", "DF-02"],
        "severity": 3
    }
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/inspections", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {r.status_code}"
    data = r.json()
    assert list(data.keys()) == ["inspection_id", "batch_code", "inspector", "passed", "defect_count"]
    assert data["batch_code"] == "BLK-101"
    assert data["inspector"] == "Jane Doe"
    assert data["passed"] is True
    assert data["defect_count"] == 3
    
    # Now check if inspection_count of BLK-101 increased by 1!
    r2 = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/batches/BLK-101")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json()["inspection_count"] > 0
    print("POST /inspections success passed.")

        "batch_code": "UNKNOWN-BATCH",
        "inspector": "Jane Doe",
        "passed": True,

    assert r.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {r.status_code}"
    assert r.json() == {"error": "batch_not_found"}
    print("POST /inspections batch not found passed.")

def test_regions_totals_success():
    print("Testing POST /regions/totals success...")
    payload = {
        "region_codes": ["NOR", "SOU"]
    }
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/regions/totals", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {r.status_code}"
    data = r.json()
    assert list(data.keys()) == ["regions"]

        assert list(reg.keys()) == ["code", "name", "grower_count", "batch_count", "total_kilograms"]

def test_other_routes_404():
    print("Testing other routes 404...")
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/invalid-path")
    assert r.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {r.status_code}"
    assert r.json() == {"error": "not_found"}

    r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/healthz")
    assert r.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {r.status_code}"
    assert r.json() == {"error": "not_found"}
    print("Other routes 404 passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_healthz()
    test_growers_search_success()
    test_growers_search_invalid()
    test_get_batch_success()
    test_get_batch_not_found()
    test_create_inspection_success()
    test_create_inspection_not_found()
    test_create_inspection_invalid()
    test_regions_totals_success()
    test_other_routes_404()
    print("\nALL TESTS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY!")
